what: The giant section name (ABOUT, WORKS, FLOW) pinned at the bottom right of the screen rises letter by letter from under a mask at .8s power3.out with .05s stagger when its section head reaches 75% of the screen, and fades out at 1.5s power2.out when the next section name turns on or when you scroll back above its section — only one is on at a time

options.dur: Duration of one character rising (sec), default .8
options.start: Line where it lights up (relative to its own section), default top 75% — the end is the line where the next section name lights up
options.look: ”left” attaches it to the bottom left
options.--fx-z: z-index (via style), default 5 — size, font and color are up to the user
